rawFindings.title: Possible error when slugizing non-string data.slug or data.title in create()
rawFindings.explanation: The original code calls slugize with data.slug || data.title without converting to string, which may cause errors if either is a non-string (e.g., number). The change ensures .toString() is called, preventing such errors.
rawFindings.suggestion: Call .toString() on (data.slug || data.title) before passing to slugize to guarantee it's a string.

rawFindings.title: Possible error when slugizing non-string data.slug in publish()
rawFindings.explanation: Original code calls slugize(data.slug, ...) without ensuring data.slug is string. This may cause errors if data.slug is a number. The change calls toString() ensuring safety.
rawFindings.suggestion: Call data.slug.toString() before passing to slugize in publish() method.
